集部五類：一曰楚辭類，二曰別集類，三曰總集類，四曰詩文評類，五曰詞曲類。
The Collections division comprises five categories: Songs of Chu, individual collections, general anthologies, poetry and prose criticism, and lyric and drama.

Imperial literary collections of the Qing: the Kangxi Emperor's First through Fourth Collections (forty, fifty, fifty, and thirty-six scrolls) and Mountain Resort Poems (two scrolls); the Yongzheng Emperor's collected writings (thirty scrolls) and Joy of the Heart Collection (two scrolls); the Qianlong Emperor's prose collections (thirty, forty-four, and sixteen scrolls), poetry collections (forty-eight through one hundred twelve scrolls across five series, plus a twenty-scroll supplement), the definitive Hall of Delighting in Goodness edition (thirty scrolls), Complete Historical Poems and Complete Rhyme Poems (two fascicles each), ballads in Bai Juyi's style (four fascicles), and Old Summer Palace poems (undivided); the Jiaqing Emperor's writings and poetry (multiple collections totaling well over two hundred scrolls), the definitive Studio of Savoring the Remainder edition with appended jottings, and a sixty-four-scroll Complete Historical Poems; the Daoguang Emperor's writings, poetry, and Studio for Cultivating Rectitude edition; the Xianfeng Emperor's writings and poetry; and the Tongzhi Emperor's writings and poetry. Literary collections of princes and members of the imperial clan are recorded in their respective biographies and are omitted from this catalog. 宋陳起江湖小集九十五卷、江湖後集二十四卷，元方迴文選顏鮑謝詩評四卷，汪澤民、張師愚宛陵群英集十二卷。 以上乾隆時敕輯。
